policy: External sources inform the proposed repository-native contract only. They do not transfer identity roots, credentials, runtime dependencies, tokens, networks, permissions, licenses, or governance authority to XR Foundry.

sources.title: Agent2Agent protocol repository at reviewed commit 98853be376c88df25e1704771cd3ea9ef8823a96
adopted_lessons: Agent descriptions and capability discovery benefit from explicit, machine-readable contracts.
limits: A2A is not required for repository-native A1 membership or Unity runtime communication.
excluded_assumptions: A protocol endpoint proves identity, independence, trust, or repository authority.

sources.title: Open Agentic Schema Framework at reviewed commit 3d1b83b6410f222ba2f920e31728041f517ecc9e
adopted_lessons: Capability records should separate declared skills, domains, and supported interfaces.
limits: XR Foundry keeps its smaller local schema and takes no OASF runtime dependency.
excluded_assumptions: Taxonomy membership is evidence that a capability works.

sources.title: Identity repository at reviewed commit 452077220fc5b7c5c5198251b945df5fe61628f2
adopted_lessons: Portable agent identity benefits from explicit issuer, subject, proof, and verification boundaries.
limits: Repository-native agent_id plus accountable principal is the proposed A1 identity root.
excluded_assumptions: A cryptographic identifier replaces an accountable human or grants a GitHub role.

sources.title: Decentralized Identifiers (DIDs) v1.0
adopted_lessons: Identifiers, controllers, verification methods, and services are distinct concepts.
limits: No DID method, ledger, resolver, or controller is selected for phase one.
excluded_assumptions: Decentralization terminology requires a blockchain or makes an identifier trustworthy.

sources.title: Verifiable Credentials Data Model v2.0
adopted_lessons: Issuer, subject, claim, evidence, status, and verification are separate roles.
limits: No credential format, wallet, issuer, verifier, or trust registry is activated.
excluded_assumptions: A signed claim is sufficient capability, independence, or governance evidence.

sources.title: About using GitHub Apps
adopted_lessons: A future agent action identity should be explicit, scoped, attributable, and revocable.
limits: This proposal installs no GitHub App and changes no account, role, permission, or setting.
excluded_assumptions: An App identity is an independent principal or receives authority from membership metadata.

sources.title: Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts specification v1.2
adopted_lessons: Claims should bind subject, provenance, producing process, and verifiable evidence.
limits: SLSA levels are not copied as Agent trust or governance levels.
excluded_assumptions: Artifact provenance proves social independence or authorizes an action.

sources.title: in-toto specifications
adopted_lessons: Evidence chains should make materials, steps, products, and responsible functionaries inspectable.
limits: No in-toto service, key, or attestation infrastructure is deployed in phase one.
excluded_assumptions: Multiple attestations derived from one source become independent evidence.

sources.title: Governing Actions, Not Agents
adopted_lessons: Authorization should be attached to bounded actions and contexts rather than broad agent identity.
limits: XR Foundry's mandate fields and authority decisions remain project design choices.
excluded_assumptions: A research proposal is production validation or an authority source.

sources.title: Epistemic Sybil Resistance
adopted_lessons: Agent counts should account for shared ancestry and correlated evidence rather than treating every output as independent.
limits: The distinct-principal plus distinct-lineage rule is a conservative XR Foundry phase-one policy.
excluded_assumptions: Lineage metadata alone eliminates collusion, common evidence, or model correlation.

sources.title: SocialSystemArena repository at reviewed commit 2bb33c643da9cc6d94823c7489074138a5a0a624
adopted_lessons: Social and governance behavior needs contextual evaluation beyond isolated task scores.
limits: No benchmark result is imported as an XR Foundry capability or trust claim.
excluded_assumptions: Passing a social benchmark grants membership, independence, or authority.

sources.title: Open Autonomy at reviewed commit b53eaa949f4749b3ee0b609998d74ee8d5e54657
adopted_lessons: A canonical agent definition and a running service instance should have separate identities and lifecycle evidence.
limits: Only identity and threshold-coordination concepts are considered; no runtime stack is adopted.
excluded_assumptions: Token, staking, bonding, wallet, service registry, consensus, or on-chain operation belongs in phase one.
